summary: node1 now serves a persistent local Alpine package repository over HTTP. The normal Alpine mirror is unreachable, and `tree 2.2.1-r0` was installed from the local repository. All state survived the required node restart.
actions_performed: Enabled the `local-apk-repository` OpenRC service on port 8080.
Made the normal Alpine mirror unreachable while preserving the original configuration backups.
Installed and executed `tree 2.2.1-r0` from the local repository.
Safely restarted node1 and verified its changed boot identity and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: Shows the indexed local APK files, active HTTP listener, retrievable `tree` index entry, enabled service, and successful post-restart recovery.
Shows the local-only repository configuration and failed normal-mirror access both before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Install a package from the local repository
evidence.summary: APK used node1:8080 to install `tree 2.2.1-r0`; the executable ran successfully and remained installed after restart.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID d5c33f49-e469-4582-9b7c-0ba6f3d4270a, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID e731b6f4-c882-4ffb-acdb-24c0399d5572, and recovered repository service, listener, data, configuration, and installed package.
